question: Does a compact geometry summary of the actual rank-one configuration at intrinsic k0 absorb the birth-age association, and does that summary transfer from N325 to held-out N425?
sampling: At each size one counter-derived permutation is shared by the two orientations. The size streams are disjoint. Retain only paths with ambient rank exactly one after k0 occupied sites.

field_definitions.essential_size: sum of occupied vertices over all current rank-one connected components
field_definitions.essential_carriers: number of current rank-one connected components; all must carry the frozen primitive line ell
field_definitions.occupied_frontier: occupied vertices in a rank-one component with at least one vacant NN neighbour
field_definitions.vacant_frontier: vacant vertices with at least one NN neighbour in a rank-one component
field_definitions.H2: vacant vertices whose insertion makes the union of ambient H1 images rank two
field_definitions.H2_theta: H2 vertices whose nonparallel closing cycle is formed inside an already rank-one incident component
field_definitions.H2_figure8: H2 vertices whose nonparallel closing cycle is formed in a rank-zero incident component while the inserted site also joins a rank-one component
field_definitions.H2_separate: H2 vertices whose nonparallel rank-zero closing carrier has no incident rank-one component; expected to vanish by torus carrier geometry but retained as an exact audit
field_definitions.H2_direction: sign of det(ell,w) after the existing primitive sign convention for a completing winding w; mixed means both signs occur for one candidate
field_definitions.next_exit: indicator that the actual uniformly next vacant site belongs to H2

model_ladder.Mcheap: M0 plus fixed dimensionless current covariates essential_size/N, essential_carriers-1, occupied_frontier/k0, vacant_frontier/(N-k0)
model_ladder.MH2: M0 plus H2/(N-k0); this is a diagnostic ceiling because H2 is the one-step hazard sufficient statistic

primary_score: absolute age-slope retention |beta_Mcheap/beta_M0|, separately by size and orientation with one common-batch delete-one covariance per size
secondary_scores: Mtyped and MH2 attenuation as mechanism diagnostics, not independent evidence
N325 geometry-only coefficient fit transferred without refitting to N425, followed by held-out line-fixed age residual slopes; source and target jackknife covariance contributions are summed

post-reveal descriptive only: after the frozen age score, use retained K1/K2 to evaluate covariance and linear explained trace of current-k0 geometry against the already external temporal mode2/mode3 scores from 5a7f2d9; this cannot alter the primary decision

exact: H2 equals brute-force one-step rank increments in exhaustive tiny tests
next_exit equals membership of the frozen next site in H2
all current rank-one carriers have the recorded ell
gates.support: at least 1000 retained risk-set rows and 25 next exits per orientation; otherwise report underpowered

interpretation_boundary: A surviving Mcheap age slope rejects lumpability of the recorded cheap current-geometry state, not intrinsic temporal memory; other current geometry remains unrecorded.

H2 is nearly definitional: conditional on the current configuration the one-step exit probability is exactly H2/(N-k0). Its attenuation is an implementation/calibration ceiling, not a discovered mechanism.
The two orientations from one size share raw randomness and are one evidence block.
The pilot is limited to 50000 paths per size. No adaptive extension is authorized by this freeze.
amendment_chronology: The first launch on both nodes exited 127 before invoking the runner because /usr/bin/time was absent. No CSV or metadata was created. Before relaunch and before any pilot reveal, K2 retention and the externally requested post-reveal temporal-mode description were added; seeds, counters, fields used by the primary model, scores, and gates are unchanged.
